problems: The Elenchus is a two-column list that the OCR interleaves; items were paired with their numbers using the Ordo and the body.
Elenchus entry 'De universali Orthodoxiæ solemnitate' (Macarius) is unlocated: the body only has an editor's footnote saying the oration is unedited (line 19367, cols 243|244).

Not entered (Elenchus omits, editorial/apparatus): Macarius Notitia (Ordo 161, line 13717), 'Notæ et variæ lectiones in orationem Macarii' (Ordo 231, line 18306), Joannes Caleca Notitia (Ordo 249, line 19651); Ordo-only works entered with listedIn: Macarius in Barbarorum incursus, Theophanes Oratio gratiarum actionis.
OCR page numbers frequently garbled (e.g. 813 for 843, 1939 for 1239, 1339 for 1329); several columns (Caleca 249-253, Gregorius Sinaita 1237-1329, Epistolae of Theophanes) rest on the page ladder.
Gregorius Sinaita's opuscula appear under the Palamas head in the Elenchus; author set to 'GREGORIUS SINAITA (printed under Palamas)' for those entries.
